_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Fifty-first scheduled run. NO NEW FINDINGS: zero matches without an existing case across 10,470 product pages on 16 serving URLs. THE HEADLINE IS A RECOVERY, NOT A FINDING. Your Roses, whose catalog returned HTTP 404 on every path on 2026-11-20, served its full 1,764-product feed again today with nothing done differently -- the same request, the same identification, three days apart. All 89 of its cases re-verified present and their held Last Verified dates have advanced. That is the second time this site has gone dark and come back unaided, and it vindicates the standing rule a second time: keep making the same request, report the gap, change nothing. Two Hillside Rose Farm listings removed since 2026-11-17 also returned (HILLSIDERO-005, -007); a return is a material event, and because the re-verify script logs it with its routine wording, the transition was recorded explicitly on both cases by hand. Xavian's Roses was refused for a third consecutive run. Ergonzi failed with a connection reset for the second time in four runs and served in full on one re-pull.
